source: Raspberry Pi RP2350B Minimal Design R4-S1
coordinate_convention: KiCad front view; +x right +y down; source RP and target RP rotation 0 degrees
cautions: Never blindly import all routing. spatial_candidate is a clipping test only, not an electrical or clearance approval.
Original reference has optional B.Cu U4 at same centre as U3. QSPI branches/vias serving U4 must be removed or rerouted because FarmMesh has only U102.
/FLASH_SS and /QSPI_SS are joined through source R10=0R. FarmMesh has no R10; target QSPI_CS needs an explicit continuous route across that removed component location.
C12 maps to C119/C120, and C20 maps to C118/C116. Do not put both target capacitors on the same coordinates: retain one reference position and place the additional part locally.
C124 (extra 4.7u near pad32) has no one-to-one reference part; place separately beside the pad32 decoupling region.
Source C6/C7 are narrow 0402 lands (0.47x0.55, centres +/-0.515). KiCad C_0402 is 0.56x0.62, centres +/-0.480. DRC and terminal geometry must be rechecked.
QFN source perimeter pad centres radius4.90 and width0.23; stock target radius4.95 and width0.20. Segment ends usually remain inside copper, but must be checked.
Original U1 has nine plated ground pads (0.6 land,0.25 drill) embedded in footprint. Target standard U101 has no such vias: add explicitly or use approved filled/capped process.
Ground/copper zones were not extracted. Restore appropriate local PGND return geometry and continuous ground reference, not just the visible traces.
R110/R111 are currently 0603 in A0 while source R7/R8 are 0402; move/resize before copying their source positions.
No source B.Cu signal/ground geometry may be mapped to an inner layer without checking the selected four-layer stack and return paths.
